data.narrative:
ABL Bio is a public-stage biotech company trading on KOSDAQ in the Biotech & Health sector. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 peers: 3 public-market tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 7 private-stage companies including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, and Freenome.

Two standard triangulation methods were evaluated. Peer-Median multiples could not be applied due to insufficient narrow-stage comparable data; while 7 same-sector peers exist, none met the filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier simultaneously, requiring a minimum of 3 datapoints. Public-Comp Anchoring was similarly inapplicable: the public Biotech & Health median P/S stands at 8.1x across the 3 public tickers identified, but ABL Bio's revenue figures are not on file, precluding application of this multiple.

The absence of both applicable triangulation methods limits derivation of a supported valuation range from the available data. A credible valuation would require either: disclosure of ABL Bio's current revenue and profitability metrics to anchor public comparables, or identification of recent funding rounds among the private peer set with disclosed valuations. The current dataset does not support quantitative synthesis. Further diligence should prioritize obtaining ABL Bio's financial disclosures and recent transaction comps from the private peer universe.
